sections.heading: About E-resources
sections.content:
COLLECTION: We have large collection of around 17504 + books, 82 National Journals for all disciplines in hard bound session. Library provided NPTEL facility & following E-Journals Resources to all the Staff & Student in APCOER E-Resources
We have an official Membership of J-Gate, DELNET and National Digital Library of India for Engineering. In this database we are Total No. of e-Journals (Total Full Text – 20011 & Indexed – 15655 e-Journal: including 2111 UGC Care List, Scopus & Web of Science rating full text e-journals)

E-Resources | Particular | Details
J-Gate (JET) | J-GATE Engineering and Technology (Total No. of e-Journals) J-Gate (JST) (Total Full Text – 20011 & Indexed – 15655 e-Journal: including 2111 UGC Care List, Scopus & Web of Science rating full text e-journals) ID: abmspuser Pass: apcoer@2024 | 
DELNET | http://www.delnet.nic.in/ (Developing Library Network) ( APCOER Membership No. IM-6642 ): 10558 free e-books in 687 categories, Number of Full Text E-Journals, Thesis, Dissertations, & Other databases are possible to remotely Access & Download ID: mhapcer Pass: apc6642 | Articles 984809, E-Books-1613 & Thesis-102096
National Digital Library (NDL) Membership | https://ndl.iitkgp.ac.in (Digital Resource provided by Ministry of Human Resource Development, India) APCOER Membership No: INMHNC4S7RXXIUG | 10048671+ E-Material
Download | E-Books, Syllabus, University Question Papers, NPTEL Text Material, News Paper Cuttings & others… URL: https://sites.google.com/view/apcoerlibraryportal Please feel free to get in touch with us if any further assistance is required…
